about: Sample routes for proxy.py. Rules name vendors ONLY by the names in the person's own ~/.config/lionsberg/vendors.json (template: vendors.sample.json); any host, scheme, base_url, port, path, url, headers or key_env here is refused at load. Fields whose names start with 'about' are comments. Rules are tried in order; the first enabled rule whose 'when' holds wins; else 'default'. A rule naming a vendor the person has not defined is skipped and said at start. Copy this file to your holon as routes.json to make it yours.
about_anthropic_version: Used only when the client sends no anthropic-version header; a client's own header always passes through unchanged.
about_hash_bodies: 'hmac' records keyed digests (HMAC-SHA256 under the holon's own salt, <holon>/.proxy-salt, kept out of git) of each request body and completion, for later matching; 'none' records no digest. Bodies themselves are never recorded.

rules.about: A request tagged private (header X-Route-Tag: private) stays on this machine. The proxy refuses to load this rule if 'local' is not on this machine, and refuses any private request that would leave it.

Fusion: the same request to several vendors, every answer returned in the 'council' field for the agent to judge, within deadline_s seconds. Off by default; set enabled to true and send X-Route-Tag: council. Every member of kind anthropic needs its own key_env; the client's credential never fans out.
Small requests for the fast tier go to the router's open model.
Between 22:00 and 06:00 local time, requests tagged batch run on the local server.
Every Claude model name goes to the Anthropic API unchanged.

default.about: When no rule matches. No model named here means the model asked for is kept.
